current_release_candidate_projection.name: Actions Runtime 1.0.3 community/native delivery slice
current_release_candidate_projection.boundary: One local/community Runtime release candidate with existing Core/Helper 1.0.3 pairing; exact #211 external native distribution contract remains required. Keep released-product safety, configured admin authorization, public package compatibility, shipped UI and actual standalone Work Items defect criteria as release gates where the corresponding surface ships. Keep local SQLite and the bounded local RCC consumer releasable; do not require PostgreSQL, independent workers, Package v3, a second adapter, durable Work Item redesign, MCP Canvas, or Control Room for this slice. This is a projection, not acceptance or release approval.
no_claims: Core/Helper 1.0.3 publication is not Runtime 1.0.3 publication.
Homebrew tap migration issue #103 is closed; #211 is the Actions-side caller and native distribution delivery, not a request to reopen the tap issue.

#153 Linux subgate is not whole acceptance.
Narrow close-ready recommendations #162/#194/#209 require owner confirmation; they are not blockers absent an explicit release relation.
An open issue means retained acceptance remains not established; it does not prove implementation absent or make it a release blocker without contract/relation.
